name: Community Route - Founders With Leads And Events

communities.blurb: For alumni building companies — from first idea to scale.
communities.body:
A working community for Harvard alumni who are building. Founder dinners, candid fundraising conversations, and small peer groups where the questions that are too early or too raw for a public stage get answered by people a year or two ahead of you.

Open to anyone alumni-affiliated who is building something — pre-idea, pre-seed, or well past it. There is no application and no stage requirement.

description: A community once it has people and a calendar behind it — the state the team is working toward, not the one production starts in. Named leads, city-specific links, and events reach the page through the same tag chapters use, so nothing about the editing model is new. Production starts with none of this, which the AI scenario shows.
